overview:
Where a traditional lift hangs on round steel wire ropes, a belt lift hangs on flat belts: steel cords sealed inside a polyurethane coat. The flat belt bends around a far smaller sheave, so the machine shrinks enough to sit inside the shaft, the machine room disappears, and the ride loses the hum and vibration that ropes carry into the car.

The coating means no lubrication and no oil on the belts, and each belt is monitored continuously, so wear is read electronically rather than by eye. For apartments, offices and hotels it gives a quiet, level, efficient lift in the same shaft a rope lift would need.

safety_features.name: Overload detection
safety_features.headline: The lift will not move if it is asked to carry too much.
safety_features.description: Load cells under the lift platform measure weight continuously. Past the rated load the doors stay open, an audible warning sounds and the lift holds at the landing until weight is removed.
safety_features.test_procedure: The lift is loaded past 110% of rated capacity; departure must be inhibited.

safety_features.name: Automatic rescue device
safety_features.headline: A power cut moves you to the nearest floor, not nowhere.
safety_features.description: On mains failure the ARD battery takes over, drives the lift at reduced speed to the nearest landing, opens the doors and holds the cabin light and fan on.
safety_features.test_procedure: Mains supply is cut mid-travel; the lift must land and release passengers unaided.

safety_features.name: Overspeed governor & safety gear
safety_features.headline: If the lift ever runs fast, steel jaws close on the rails.
safety_features.description: An overspeed governor senses descent above the trip speed and mechanically engages progressive safety gear, which grips the guide rails and brings the lift to a controlled stop.
safety_features.test_procedure: The governor is tripped at rated overspeed with the lift loaded; the safety gear must set and hold on the rails.

safety_features.name: Firefighter recall
safety_features.headline: In an alarm the lift stops being a lift and becomes an exit route.
safety_features.description: On a fire signal the lift cancels all calls, returns to the designated evacuation landing, parks with doors open and locks out normal operation until reset.
safety_features.test_procedure: The fire input is asserted; the lift must recall and park without accepting further calls.

safety_features.name: Door light curtain
safety_features.headline: The doors see you before they touch you.
safety_features.description: A full-height infrared curtain across the entrance re-opens the doors on any obstruction, with no contact required.
safety_features.test_procedure: The curtain is broken at multiple heights while closing; doors must reverse each time.

safety_features.name: Alarm & two-way intercom
safety_features.headline: Someone answers, day or night.
safety_features.description: The alarm button connects to a battery-backed intercom that reaches Zion's 24/7 service desk, independent of the building's power.
safety_features.test_procedure: The alarm is pressed with mains isolated; a voice link must be established.
